decisions.statement: The tree is the domain tree narrowed to commands and namespaces.
A page hangs where the page above names that page rather than by its hyphens.
The roots are the parts of the command page type.
A part of the command page type that is neither a command nor a namespace goes.
A row is labelled by the whole call that row is made by.
A label parts the words of a call by spaces rather than by hyphens.
A call written with spaces reaches the command the hyphens reach.
A row has the whole name the harness is called by.
The rows under one row are in alphabetical order.
A namespace is ordered among the commands rather than apart from the commands.
A row's detail is the definition its own page states.
A command or namespace no root reaches is named as unreached.
Nothing here walks the file system.
A reader here takes the repository root or a reading of the index.
Every question one call asks is asked of one reading.

definition: the namespaces and commands under the command page type, gathered into one tree
